items.title: How Investors May Respond To General Mills (GIS) Dividend Cut Risk
items.summary: General Mills outlined a major reorganization effective January 2027, creating three reporting segments and a new Commercial function. The company is also partnering with Dunkin’ on limited-time cereal products and keeping its quarterly dividend at US$0.61 a share.
